# iyulab web UI libraries

> Lit-based web components and application libraries for line-of-business web apps, published on npm under the `@iyulab/*` scope. A package that has an agent skill ships it inside its npm tarball: read its `SKILL.md` first, then the `references/` it points to.

Packages register their custom elements when imported. The components package carries the design tokens; the guide below shows the pieces working together.

## Guide

- [House-style guide and reference app](https://iyulab.github.io/house-style/): the guide is the place to see the packages used together; the reference app is a working line-of-business example.

## Packages

- [@iyulab/components](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/components/skills/iyulab-components/SKILL.md): Lit-based UI elements for business web apps: buttons, inputs, selects, date pickers, dialogs, design tokens, theming and a locale registry. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/components), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-components).
- [@iyulab/house-style](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/house-style): The iyulab house theme: a CSS-only theme for @iyulab components — tokens, component recipes, line-of-business layout patterns and a Tailwind CSS v4 preset — plus the guide site that documents it. [source](https://github.com/iyulab/house-style).
- [@iyulab/modern-app](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/modern-app/skills/modern-app/SKILL.md): Application shell for Lit web apps: layout, sidebar, command palette, routing and app lifecycle. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/modern-app), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-modern-app).
- [@iyulab/router](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/router/skills/iyulab-router/SKILL.md): A modern client-side router for web applications with support for Lit and React components. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/router), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-router).
- [@iyulab/data-components](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/data-components/skills/iyulab-data-components/SKILL.md): Data elements for Lit apps: rich table, simple sheet and record picker. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/data-components), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-data-components).
- [@iyulab/flex-table](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/flex-table/skills/iyulab-flex-table/SKILL.md): A minimalist, input-centric data grid web component. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/flex-table), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/flex-table).
- [@iyulab/enterprise](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/enterprise/skills/iyulab-enterprise/SKILL.md): Business-app building blocks: OData service client, sign-in and list-page scaffolding. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/enterprise), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-enterprise).
- [@iyulab/chat-components](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/chat-components/skills/iyulab-chat-components/SKILL.md): Chat interface and streaming Markdown blocks for LLM front ends. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/chat-components), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-chat-components).
- [@iyulab/editor-components](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/editor-components/skills/iyulab-editor-components/SKILL.md): Rich-text editor web components. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/editor-components), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-editor-components).
- [@iyulab/u-widgets](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/u-widgets/skills/iyulab-u-widgets/SKILL.md): Declarative, data-driven widget system for visualization and input. Also ships an MCP server (`@iyulab/u-widgets-mcp`). [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/u-widgets), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/u-widgets).
- [@iyulab/dimension-timeline](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/dimension-timeline): A timeline component for visualizing tasks across customizable dimensions with collision-aware layout. [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-dimension-timeline).
- [@iyulab/http-client](https://unpkg.com/@iyulab/http-client/skills/iyulab-http-client/SKILL.md): HTTP client with typed responses and errors, upload and streaming. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/http-client), [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-http-client).
- [@iyulab/flex-components](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@iyulab/flex-components): Data preprocessing utilities for sheet-shaped data and number arrays (pure functions). [source](https://github.com/iyulab/node-flex-components).
